description:
Cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.


Reliability fixes for submitting and loading states
- Fixed Enter being swallowed while using a Chinese/Japanese/Korean input method: the keystroke that commits the IME candidate no longer requires a second Enter to submit (#1919)
- Fixed the UI getting stuck on "Translating..." forever after switching languages or clearing OCR text mid-translation (#1919)
- Submitting now falls back to the first available action and shows a clear message when the built-in translate action was renamed or deleted, instead of doing nothing (#1919)
- Fixed background requests in the browser extension hanging forever on connection errors (#1918)
